# Results (aggregate, regenerated by `scripts/run_pipeline.py`; code commit in `run_summary.json`)

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `tables/vintage_inventory.csv` | 16 verified vintages: source, nominal and public-by dates, SHA-256, rows, placeholders dropped, H1 completeness and maturity |
| `tables/cross_vintage_exclusions.csv` | Join audit: every (country, year) unit's status per comparison and tier (included, metadata changed, absent/failing in early or late file) |
| `tables/cross_vintage_comparisons.csv` | Per comparison x tier x metadata rule: units, countries, reversals at 5/10/15/20%, revision summaries |
| `tables/cross_vintage_by_analysis.csv` | Aggregated by analysis (C1 primary; S1, S3, S4), unbalanced and balanced samples |
| `tables/cross_vintage_bootstrap.csv` | Country-cluster bootstrap CIs on reversal shares (all thresholds) and mean absolute ratio revision |
| `tables/defer_rule_grid.csv` | Defer rule over thresholds x buffers x cost ratios; `primary_rule` marks k=0.10, buffer 0.03, strict, identical |
| `tables/cross_vintage_units.csv` | Unit-level ratios in both files and metadata (WHO national aggregates; no free text) |
| `tables/*_who_prov_2026-10-17.csv` | Within-vintage audit of the current public file (coverage, pair flow, threshold counts, ratios, bootstrap) |
| `figures/c1_revision_scatter.png` | Early vs reference H1 ratio, reversals highlighted |
| `figures/c1_defer_tradeoff.png` | Deferrals vs remaining reversals by buffer |
| `figures/s4_h1_2021_maturity.png` | H1 2021 comparability across nine 2021 snapshots |
| `figures/coverage_*.png`, `figures/h1_ratios_*.png` | Coverage thinning; within-vintage ratios |

Cross-vintage results are retrospective and exploratory (see `docs/STATUS.md`). Within-vintage statistics
describe year-on-year change, not revision reliability.
